title: Why Venus is a wandering star
description:
Astronomers found in 1890 that Spica is two blue stars orbiting every 4 days. This year a report says it has a third star.
NASA picture: HQ, NHQ202605180002. NASA/Bill Ingalls, 18 May 2026.
Every day’s picture: https://cosmos.rimilab.com/
Today’s APOD photo is by Włodzimierz Bubak: https://science.nasa.gov/image-article/apod-2026-november-12-moon-venus-and-spica-meet/. To use it, please ask the owner.
